title: Yellow Molten Chinese Chicken Ma La Tang
description: A festive and umami Chinese dish featuring sweet chilli sauce and robata-grilled chicken, served in a low-calorie ma la tang style.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sweet chilli sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce mixture.
Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the chicken for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the ma la tang by heating the sweet chilli sauce in a small saucepan over low heat.
To assemble the dish, place the grilled chicken in a bowl and spoon the molten sweet chilli sauce over the top.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve immediately.
